title: Baseline objective check
summary: Complete an untutored, mixed diagnostic covering vocabulary, grammar/cloze and reading.

provenance.authored_by: Codex English V3-B Sprint breadth milestone

sections.title: Define an honest starting point
content: A useful baseline shows what the learner can do today, not the highest score achievable with help.

sections.title: Protect independent conditions
content: Use one timed attempt without hints, dictionaries, translation, AI or another person.
Resume the same saved attempt after a technical interruption and record the interruption.

sections.title: Interpret only what was measured
content: The objective baseline produces a starting strand profile, not an admission prediction or permanent ability label.
It does not directly assess a full composition.

sections.title: Separate valid and contaminated attempts
content: Decide whether each scenario preserves independent conditions, introduces help or requires an interruption note.

sections.title: Prepare the attempt
content: Choose a quiet session, stable device and honest no-help agreement. Submit once rather than shopping for a better score.

sections.title: Name validity threats
content: Classify threats as assistance, repeated exposure, changed conditions, interrupted session or over-interpretation.

sections.title: Check baseline readiness
content: This five-decision readiness check is not the protected 20-part baseline.
